Synopsis:
    US index futures were broadly flat on Sept 3, with Dow E-minis marginally positive (+0.17%), S&P flat (+0.05%), and NQ/Nasdaq slightly negative (-0.04%). Sentiment is dampened by elevated oil prices and Middle East escalation risk following US-Iran military exchanges. Treasury yields are easing after a prolonged selloff that had weighed on equities. AI-related earnings expectations remain a high bar — Broadcom missed its Q4 revenue forecast, pulling its stock lower premarket. Snowflake surged +23.76% on strong forward guidance. Friday's nonfarm payrolls report is the key near-term catalyst for Fed rate path pricing.
